将粗略的草图变成成品图像

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的草图。线条画、涂鸦或粗略的概念。上下文遵循您绘制的形状和构图。适用于：角色概念·产品设计·故事板·线条艺术

步骤 2. 写下您的风格提示。描述完成的外观，例如“将此草图渲染为逼真的照片”或“将此草图变成水彩画”。风格越清晰，结果越接近。

步骤 3. 点击运行并下载。您将获得根据草图构建的渲染图像。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。适用于：Photoshop · Figma · Canva · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认设置（大约 20 个步骤·指导 2.5·您的草图自动缩放到 Kontext 的大小）是几乎每个草图的正确起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 FLUX.1 Kontext（Black Forest Labs 的开放权重编辑模型）将草图转换为成品图像。 Kontext 将您的草图作为参考，将您的提示作为说明，因此它会保留您绘制的形状和构图，同时以您描述的风格渲染它们。您上传草图，编写简短的样式提示，然后在大约 24 秒内返回全彩图像。它适用于逼真的照片、绘画、产品渲染或您能说出的任何外观。无需设置，无需连接节点。

适用人群：想要在 ComfyUI 中使用 FLUX Kontext 渲染草图而无需从头开始设置模型和节点的创作者。不适用于：零调整的一键结果。粗略的草图和模糊的提示给出了粗略的结果。你还是引导风格。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传你的草图。

  2. 编写样式提示（例如“将此草图渲染为逼真的照片”），然后运行。

  3. 下载完成的图像，为任何编辑器做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每个渲染大约在 24 秒内返回，因此在同一个草图上尝试不同的样式可以保持快速。需要了解的一个限制是：FLUX.1 Kontext 采用非商业许可，因此商业用途需要与 Black Forest Labs 签订单独的协议。

使用案例

概念和角色设计。将粗略的人物草图变成您想要的风格的成品艺术作品。

产品与工业设计。将产品草图渲染为逼真的照片或干净的模型。

风格探索。尝试使用与照片、绘画或 3D 渲染相同的草图来比较方向。

故事板和插图。将线条艺术和粗糙面板快速提升为全彩。

Flux Kontext 可以生成什么？

o.en:
Turn a rough sketch into a finished image

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your sketch. A line drawing, a doodle, or a rough concept. Kontext follows the shapes and composition you drew. Works great with: character concepts · product designs · storyboards · line art

Step 2. Write your style prompt. Describe the finished look, like "render this sketch as a realistic photo" or "turn this sketch into a watercolor painting." The clearer the style, the closer the result.

Step 3. Hit run and download. You get back the rendered image, built from your sketch. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Photoshop · Figma · Canva · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (about 20 steps · guidance 2.5 · your sketch auto-scaled to Kontext's size) are the right starting point for almost every sketch.

Overview

This workflow turns a sketch into a finished image using FLUX.1 Kontext, an open-weight editing model from Black Forest Labs. Kontext reads your sketch as a reference and your prompt as the instruction, so it keeps the shapes and composition you drew while rendering them in the style you describe. You upload a sketch, write a short style prompt, and get back a full-color image in about 24 seconds. It works for a realistic photo, a painting, a product render, or any look you can name. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators who want to render sketches with FLUX Kontext in ComfyUI without setting up the model and nodes from scratch. Not for: one-click results with zero tuning. A rough sketch and a vague prompt give a rough result. You still guide the style.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your sketch.

  2. Write a style prompt (like "render this sketch as a realistic photo"), then run.

  3. Download the finished image, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each render comes back in about 24 seconds, so trying different styles on the same sketch stays quick. One limit to know: FLUX.1 Kontext is under a non-commercial license, so commercial use needs a separate agreement with Black Forest Labs.

Use Cases

Concept & Character Design. Turn rough character sketches into finished art in the style you want.

Product & Industrial Design. Render a product sketch as a realistic photo or a clean mockup.

Style Exploration. Try the same sketch as a photo, a painting, or a 3D render to compare directions.

Storyboards & Illustration. Bring line art and rough panels up to full color fast.
